text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — Nimbus pinged about Argentina edge region listing in the cloud marketplace + NVIDIA-backed capacity for our managed edge SKUs. They want quota approvals, SI integration checks, and a joint announcement window. Who can lead the quota request?
Mike: I can run the quota request with cloud-ops. Will need exact SKU names and expected QPS.
Carlos (Nimbus): thx Mike — expected steady peak 12k tokens/s, burst to 30k for first 2 weeks of launch. SKUs: `redwood-edge-arg-a10x` and `redwood-edge-arg-a10x-burst`.
Sofia: I’ll take partner contract / legal review. Can you share the NIL agreement draft and any data processing notes, @Carlos (Nimbus)?
Carlos (Nimbus): attaching the partner doc in the marketplace portal — link: https://marketplace.nimbus.example/partners/redwood/argentina — also pinged legal via email.
Mike: cloud-ops checklist: 1) quota request ticket to cloud provider 2) capacity reservation confirmation 3) KMS key provisioning in AR region 4) test deploy on a1.2 nodes. I’ll open the ticket today.
Anya: also loop in infra for kernel perf — NVIDIA quantized path needs validation for 2048 context perf on A10X. @Sofia, can we get a security assessment for data residency?
Sofia: yes, will ask security for PII residency checklist. timeline?
Anya: target internal approvals by Tue next week, public announcement two weeks after that. Nimbus wants press coordination same day as marketplace availability.
Mike: opened quota ticket — ID #Q-2317 — pasted below for reference:
```
{
  "region": "argentina-central-1",
  "resource": "gpu.a10x",
  "initial_quota": 40,
  "burst_quota": 100,
  "justification": "Marketplace launch with Nimbus — expected initial traffic burst and SI onboarding"
}
```
Mike: added contact @infra-team and @kms-admins to the ticket.
Carlos (Nimbus): AndesSI (our systems integrator in AR) will run a preflight integration next week. Can Redwood provide test credentials and a small sandbox token bucket?
Anya: yes — we can provision a sandbox account: `rbwd-arg-sandbox` with 10 concurrent capacity for AndesSI. Mike — please create and share creds with Carlos.
Mike: done. I shared a one-time link to the creds in the ticket and set expiry for 7 days.
deploy-bot: Deployment plan created: /deployments/redwood-arg-marketplace-2026 (id: dpl-4812). Status: pending validations.
Sofia: for the joint announcement copy, Marketing will want a two-sentence product blurb + 3 bullets on gov/compliance. @Anya can you draft bullet points by Friday?
Anya: yes, will draft. Action items recap: Mike -> follow quota/ticket and confirm reservation; Sofia -> legal + security signoff; Carlos -> share marketplace partner doc and coordinate AndesSI; Anya -> announcement copy + perf validation schedule.
Carlos (Nimbus): thanks team — Nimbus will aim to confirm marketplace listing date by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
Mike: noted. I’ll post updates in this thread and the #deployments channel.
Anya: perfect. if blockers pop, call a 15m sync. Thanks all. :rocket:
